column1: # shell: bash zsh fish nu pwsh dash ash rbash. profile: a name labd.py knows (default, banner, rcerr, ..., see usersdb.PROFILES).
# sshd fragment: directives separated by ';' placed in `Match User <user>`; '-' = none. Parsed by usersdb.py (harness selftest too).
# Never put keys, passwords or hostnames here: labd.py generates them per lease.
